mapper.select: SELECT item_id AS id, item_nm AS itemNm, item_category AS itemCategory, seller_id AS sellerId, seller_nm AS sellerNm, price AS price, stock_number AS stockNumber, item_detail AS itemDetail, place AS place, item_sell_status AS itemSellStatus, reg_time AS regTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM item WHERE item_id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM item ORDER BY price DESC

SELECT item_id AS id, item_nm AS itemNm, item_category AS itemCategory, seller_id AS sellerId, seller_nm AS sellerNm, price AS price, stock_number AS stockNumber, item_detail AS itemDetail, place AS place, item_sell_status AS itemSellStatus, reg_time AS regTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM item ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET item_nm = #{itemNm}, item_category = #{itemCategory}, seller_id = #{sellerId}, seller_nm = #{sellerNm}, price = #{price}, stock_number = #{stockNumber}, item_detail = #{itemDetail}, place = #{place}, item_sell_status = #{itemSellStatus}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE item_id = #{id}
